caption: The drawing shows the silhouette of a four-legged animal, resembling a llama or alpaca, standing on a horizontal bar. The animal is depicted in a dark brown to black color, with some rust or weathered spots visible on its body, suggesting a metallic texture. The animal has a slightly elevated head, erect ears, and a short tail. The background behind the animal is a uniform light beige or muted tan, and the main drawing is enclosed in a square with faint borders. Below the animal, there is text that reads: "WEATHER-VANE. 1/6 ACTUAL SIZE." and beneath that, the name "ELMER C. ANDERSON" is written. The entire composition is centered within a larger light beige rectangular frame, with wide margins around the main image and inscriptions.
title: Weather Vane
